Hi all,

Draft answers below (copied into a single block you can paste into the questionnaire). I also attached a short factsheet and a simple diagram showing request flow and where data is transient vs persisted. Priyom — please confirm the attachment link before we send externally.

Draft answers (hosted API):

1) Regions and tenant isolation:
- Redwood-hosted API supports customer data residency in US and EU regions by default: US (us-west-2, us-east-1) and EU (eu-west-1).
- For customers requiring strict geographic control we offer Dedicated pools (reserved capacity) and Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) to ensure compute and storage remain within a customer-specified boundary.

2) Default retention windows (hosted API):
- Request logs (request metadata and anonymized diagnostic traces): 90 days by default; configurable down to 0 days on request for enterprise plans.
- Optional debug logs (full request/response bodies retained for troubleshooting): off by default; retained 7 days if enabled and only with explicit customer consent.
- KV and prefix caches: ephemeral in-memory caches with TTLs typically under 24 hours; no persistent customer-level cache by default.
- System backups and snapshots: rolling snapshots retained for 30 days for disaster recovery; snapshots are stored with logical separation per tenancy where feasible.

3) Customer data deletion (tenant erasure) workflow and timeline:
- Initiation: customer files an erasure request via Console or support ticket (we provide a templated form).
- Internal validation: Security & Ops validate the request and identify associated tenant objects (1 business day).
- Primary deletion: wipe of customer data in live stores and caches (SLO: 3 business days).
- Backup purge: removal from backups/snapshots on next retention cycle (SLO: up to 30 days; expedited purge possible via contract).
- Confirmation: we provide a deletion report summarizing actions taken and objects removed.

4) Backups scope and retention:
- Backups are created from logical store snapshots and are scoped by tenant where supported by the underlying store. Some lower-level infrastructure backups (image-level) may not be tenant-scoped; we minimize the window and can provide contractual protections for regulated customers.

5) Attestation and evidence:
- For enterprise customers we provide a deletion attestation letter and can include a timestamped audit record from our internal ticketing and audit logs.
- We support SOC2-style evidence and can include relevant log extracts in an evidence pack (redacted as needed).

Notes/limitations:
- Hosted API is multi-tenant by default; for strict physical separation recommend Redwood Dedicated or Private deployments.
- We can negotiate shorter backup retention and expedited purge SLOs in contract for regulated customers.

Suggested next steps for Acumen: review this draft and let us know which specific controls/retention numbers you want enforced contractually. If they require a certified on-prem or VPC-only deployment we should loop in Solutions Engineering for scope and pricing.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor

Sara / Mike,

Thanks for the questionnaire and the quick turnaround window. Below are our consolidated responses for the hosted API (we've attached a PDF one-pager and an evidence factsheet to this reply). If you'd like a short call to walk these items with your security team, Ben and I are available next week.

Key responses (summary):
- Regions available: US (us-west-2, us-east-1) and EU (eu-west-1). Dedicated/Private options available for single-tenant physical separation.
- Default retention: request metadata and anonymized traces 90 days; optional debug bodies 7 days (disabled by default); KV/prefix caches ephemeral (<24h).
- Erasure workflow: initiation via Console or support ticket -> internal validation (1 business day) -> primary deletion from live stores (SLO: 3 business days) -> backup purge on retention cycle (up to 30 days; expedited contractual options available).
- Backups: rolling snapshots retained 30 days; where possible snapshots are tenant-scoped; image-level infra backups may not be tenant-scoped but window is minimized and contractual protections can be provided.
- Evidence: deletion confirmation letter and timestamped audit extracts are available for enterprise customers.

If Acumen needs specific numbers shorter than the defaults above (for example, 30-day request-log retention or 0-day retention), we can add those to contract language or switch you to a Dedicated/Private deployment.

2) If you need an attestation, tell us the recipient and any required fields and we will produce a deletion attestation (standard delivery within 3 business days after purge).
